name: Vajra West City
description: A 13-acre community of six towers on the Nehru Outer Ring Road at Osman Nagar, with 2.5 and 3 BHK homes. About 2,00,000 sq.ft of amenities include a G+6 clubhouse, a 175 ft infinity pool, and a 50 m wide forest trail.
curation: Towers sit right beside the Outer Ring Road, with unrestricted views across it
A G+6 clubhouse with four banquet halls, 11 guest suites, and a co-working space
About 78% of the site is open space, and the layouts are Vastu compliant
connectivity: About 15 min to the Financial District
About 6 min to Birla Open Minds International School
About 33 min to Rajiv Gandhi International Airport
developerNote: Vajra Infra has been building homes in West Hyderabad for over 15 years, with residential projects in Tellapur and Osman Nagar close to the Outer Ring Road.
photoDescription: Aerial view of the towers beside the Outer Ring Road
